description: Na₄MgV₂O₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.52 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.22 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with six equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.41 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.39 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₄MgV pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₄MgV pentagonal pyramids, corners with three equivalent ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgV₃ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₄MgV pentagonal pyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₂MgV₃ octahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and three V atoms to form distorted ONa₂MgV₃ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgV₃ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₄MgV pentagonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent ONa₄MgV pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three V atoms to form ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six equivalent ONa₄MgV pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂MgV₃ octahedra.
